# S103 — Version and logo polish: clear the stale marker after a daemon restart; keep --version script-friendly

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

S54 relay later notes. (a) The TUI reads the stale-daemon marker once at startup, so it does not clear after ork daemon restart until the TUI restarts. (b) ork --version prints the version var ('dev') while the header shows the short revision. (c) The mark prints on redirected stdout too, so line 1 of ork --version is no longer 'ork VERSION'; scripts and doctor's own probe that read line 1 see glyphs (the spec and tests pinned the mark first). Open for the owner: print the mark only when stdout is a terminal (and a plain 'ork VERSION' line first or only otherwise), or keep the mark always. (d) The mono mark drops the bottom pixel of two-colour cells (owner's pinned glyph, noted only). (e) UI-pass ideas not adopted: a '! ' prefix on the warning in mono, a version in doctor text output, a darker teal for light terminals, truecolor downsampling for --version/doctor.

## Files

- `internal/tui/model.go` and `view.go`: re-read the daemon build on each snapshot or refresh so the stale marker clears after a restart.
- `cmd/ork/main.go` and `internal/brand/mark.go`: the mark only on a terminal; `ork --version` prints `ork VERSION` first on a pipe (owner decides, see Why).
- `internal/cli/doctor.go`: include the version in the text output; the firstLine probe.
- Tests beside each; `testdata/golden/version-*.txt`; `docs/dashboard.md`, `docs/design.md`.

## Failing tests

- TestVersionLineIsFirstOnAPipe: with stdout not a terminal, line 1 of ork --version is `ork VERSION` and no glyphs (once the owner confirms).
- TestDoctorTextShowsTheVersion.
- Golden views if the header changes.

## Implement

1. Ask the owner the open point (mark on a pipe) first: adj ask, then wait. 2. Tests first. 3. Fix (a), (c), and add the doctor version. 4. Goldens and docs. UI slice: UI pass (r14).
